races.name: Virgin Bet Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Virgin Bet Interactive Handicap

runners_data.name: Southern Warrior
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent recent 6f good ground form including a win, needs strong pace

runners_data.name: Staniel Cay
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but lacks recent winning form on similar conditions

runners_data.name: Orange Emperor
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent performer at 6f on good ground but no wins in recent similar conditions

runners_data.name: Escape Plan
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who showed good form with recent second, controls the race tempo

runners_data.name: Zoustar Dreams
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid recent placing record, needs pace collapse to be effective

races.paceDynamic: Escape Plan appears the most likely leader with three prominent runners (Staniel Cay, Orange Emperor, Escape Plan) ensuring a solid gallop from the start. Southern Warrior and Zoustar Dreams will rely on strong finishes from the back, meaning the pace should be honest enough to set up a finishing kick over this 6f trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained gallop favors closers
scenarios.trigger: If Escape Plan leads with Orange Emperor and Staniel Cay tracking closely through halfway
scenarios.body: The pace stays strong throughout allowing Southern Warrior and Zoustar Dreams to unleash their finishing kicks. The hold-up horses sweep past tiring leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate pace tactical finish
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent trio settle into a steadier rhythm without serious pressure
scenarios.body: Orange Emperor and Staniel Cay get first run on Escape Plan turning for home. The moderate pace doesn't fully suit the hold-up horses who need more pace collapse.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Escape Plan dominates throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Escape Plan gets an easy lead with the other prominent runners not pressing early
scenarios.body: Escape Plan controls the tempo and has enough left to repel challenges from both prominent and hold-up horses. Recent second at 6f on good ground suggests this scenario is viable.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy pace suits versatility
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners engage in early skirmishing creating uneven fractions
scenarios.body: The inconsistent pace creates gaps and positioning problems favoring horses that can adapt. Orange Emperor's consistent 6f form and Southern Warrior's tactical speed become crucial.

watchPoints.text: Escape Plan getting an uncontested lead could prove difficult to peg back over 6f
Southern Warrior needs the prominent runners to engage early to set up his finishing kick
Orange Emperor and Staniel Cay must position close enough to challenge without getting involved in pace battles
Zoustar Dreams requires a genuinely strong gallop to maximize hold-up style effectiveness
The compact field of five could create traffic problems if the pace becomes tactical

races.name: Virgin Bet Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: Plaid
runners_data.note: Excellent going record (2/2 with 1W 2P) suggests conditions suit perfectly for pace-setting role

runners_data.name: Jazzy Baby
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner with strong going form (6/6 starts) makes her reliable pace partner

runners_data.name: Touted Plan
runners_data.note: Recent heavy ground struggles but class hold-up performer who excels when pace is strong

runners_data.name: Holy Fire
runners_data.note: Solid going form (14/15 starts) but needs strong pace to unleash finishing kick from rear

runners_data.name: Melody De Vega
runners_data.note: Limited recent runs but perfect going record (3/3) suggests freshness could be key asset

runners_data.name: Art Gallery
runners_data.note: Last-start winner with excellent going form who benefits from patient hold-up tactics

runners_data.name: Izz'nt She Hot
runners_data.note: Prominent style offers tactical flexibility between leading group and hold-up horses

races.paceDynamic: Plaid and Jazzy Baby will likely share early pace-setting duties, with Izz'nt She Hot also capable of taking a prominent position. This creates a sustainable tempo with multiple hold-up horses (Touted Plan, Holy Fire, Melody De Vega, Art Gallery) tracking behind, setting up tactical finish where positioning and timing will be crucial.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Plaid and Jazzy Baby establish comfortable early fractions without pressure
scenarios.body: The pace-setters maintain their advantage as the hold-up brigade struggle to make up ground in the straight. Plaid's excellent going record and Jazzy Baby's consistency under these conditions prove decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes moderate allowing closers to conserve energy
scenarios.body: Touted Plan and Art Gallery benefit from patient rides and strong finishing kicks to overhaul the leaders. Both horses show class when able to unleash their finishing speed from off the pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Plaid and Jazzy Baby go too fast early and tie up in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The entire field converges in a messy finish as the pace-setters weaken dramatically. Holy Fire's stamina and Melody De Vega's tactical speed prove valuable in the scramble.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Izz'nt She Hot Perfectly Positioned
scenarios.trigger: If Izz'nt She Hot settles closer than usual while others commit too early or late
scenarios.body: Her prominent racing style allows her to avoid trouble while tracking the leaders perfectly. She times her challenge to perfection as both front-runners and hold-up horses struggle with their positioning.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Plaid and Jazzy Baby go too fast early - could set up complete pace collapse
Monitor Touted Plan's jumping from the gates - recent heavy ground form suggests possible sharpness issues
Observe Art Gallery's positioning early - needs to be handy enough to mount challenge but not get involved in pace battle
Check Holy Fire's early movement - must be within striking distance by halfway to be competitive
Watch for Melody De Vega's fitness after light recent campaign - could be vulnerable if pace is strong throughout

runners_data.name: Aukus

runners_data.name: Liveinthelight
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who consistently fades late despite strong positioning through races.

runners_data.name: Semper Femina
runners_data.note: Unexposed filly whose running style and stamina for this trip remain question marks.

runners_data.name: Semele
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who has raced prominently in recent outings on similar ground.

runners_data.name: Calypso Bloom
runners_data.note: Fades badly in finish but has shown glimpses of ability when getting favorable pace setup.

runners_data.name: Shushi
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who will track the leaders and provide main early pace alongside Semele.

runners_data.name: Shirakawa
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who struggles to finish strongly but suits patient ride over longer trips.

runners_data.name: Galaxy Star
runners_data.note: Pure closer with proven stamina who needs strong pace to show best form.

runners_data.name: Six Blue
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who consistently fades despite getting into good positions entering straight.

races.paceDynamic: Semele appears the natural leader with Shushi likely tracking in second, creating a modest tempo in the early stages. With only two confirmed pace-setters and a strong hold-up contingent including Galaxy Star, Liveinthelight, and Six Blue, this sets up perfectly for closers to deliver late challenges over this staying trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Dominate Late
scenarios.trigger: If Semele and Shushi set conservative fractions and kick clear approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: The pace collapses as hold-up horses sweep past the leaders in the final 200 yards. Galaxy Star and Liveinthelight benefit most from their patient tactics.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Pair Hold On
scenarios.trigger: If Semele maintains strong gallop and Shushi stays close enough to challenge
scenarios.body: The early pace proves sustainable as the leaders resist late pressure. Semele's stamina and Shushi's tactical speed prove decisive against the closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Raider Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly-raced fillies shows significant improvement and races prominently
scenarios.body: Aukus or Semper Femina travel strongly in third or fourth and quicken past tiring leaders. Their unexposed nature catches the more experienced runners off guard.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If both Semele and Shushi fade dramatically entering the straight
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a messy finish where any horse can win. The race becomes a sprint finish favoring those with turn of foot regardless of position.

watchPoints.text: Semele's early fractions will dictate whether this becomes closer-friendly or front-runner dominated.
Galaxy Star's position turning for home as she needs to be within striking distance despite hold-up style.
Liveinthelight and Six Blue both show concerning fade patterns despite getting good race positions.
Aukus and Semper Femina represent unknown quantities whose debut/early running could surprise experienced rivals.
Shushi's ability to sustain challenge if Semele kicks clear will determine whether leaders can hold off closers.

races.name: Virgin Bet A Good Bet Handicap

runners_data.name: Straight A
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner with excellent similar going record of 8 places from 15 starts

runners_data.name: Me Tarzan
runners_data.note: Strong recent winner from this distance with solid going record including two wins from eleven similar conditions starts

runners_data.name: Shamacid
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner but winless on similar going despite six placed efforts from ten attempts

runners_data.name: Tattie Bogle
runners_data.note: Natural leader with recent win on similar going and consistent place record at this trip

runners_data.name: Our Dagger
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with two recent wins at this distance, though coming off heavy/soft going disappointments

runners_data.name: Lunanova
runners_data.note: Late-running type with impressive three wins from similar going conditions and strong finishing kick

races.paceDynamic: Shamacid and Tattie Bogle will contest the early lead with both confirmed front runners in a small field, creating an honest gallop from flag to finish. The pace pressure between these two leaders should set up the race perfectly for the hold-up horses Our Dagger and Lunanova, while prominent runners Straight A and Me Tarzan will track just behind the pace battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Collapses
scenarios.trigger: If Shamacid and Tattie Bogle engage in a speed duel through halfway
scenarios.body: The two leaders burn each other up in the early exchanges, dying in the final furlong as the race comes back to them. Our Dagger and Lunanova benefit most from their hold-up tactics as the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Tattie Bogle or Shamacid establishes a clear lead without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The winner dictates fractions and has enough left for the finish, with the prominent runners unable to close the gap. Tattie Bogle's superior recent form gives him the edge over Shamacid in this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is honest but sustainable, allowing tracking horses to strike
scenarios.body: Straight A and Me Tarzan get the perfect trip tracking the leaders before unleashing finishing kicks. Me Tarzan's two wins from similar going conditions give him a slight advantage over Straight A.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Excel
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is very strong throughout and the race completely falls apart
scenarios.body: Our Dagger repeats his recent winning form while Lunanova's three wins on similar going prove decisive. The front runners and prominent racers all fade badly after unsustainable early fractions.

watchPoints.text: Shamacid and Tattie Bogle go too fast early and set up the race for the closers behind them
Our Dagger may struggle if the pace isn't strong enough to set up his hold-up running style
Me Tarzan has winning form at this exact distance and going combination from his recent victory
Lunanova needs a strong pace to be effective given his hold-up tactics and closing style
The small field of six may result in a more tactical affair than the front runners' styles suggest

runners_data.name: Denby's Dream

runners_data.name: Archangel Josepi

runners_data.name: Quick Quasar
runners_data.note: Improving prominent runner with recent second at this trip and distance combination

runners_data.name: Superstorm
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who showed best recent form when third over 7f at this course last time

runners_data.name: Prancy Peer

runners_data.name: Parole Board

races.paceDynamic: Amber Hamur stands alone as the sole committed front runner and will dictate terms from the gates, likely getting an uncontested lead in this small field. With Archangel Josepi and Quick Quasar providing the only prominent challenge, the pace should be sustainable rather than frantic, setting up a tactical finish where hold-up horses like South Coast Star and Denby's Dream can mount late charges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Amber Hamur breaks cleanly and faces no early pressure from the prominent runners
scenarios.body: She gets soft fractions on the front end and has enough left to resist late challengers. The lack of pace pressure allows her to dictate ideal splits and kick clear in the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pace Duel
scenarios.trigger: If Quick Quasar and Archangel Josepi both race keenly and press Amber Hamur early
scenarios.body: The increased tempo compromises all three pace angles, creating perfect conditions for the hold-up brigade. South Coast Star gets the ideal strong pace setup to unleash her finishing kick.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Slow Pace
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners settle and allow Amber Hamur to crawl through early splits
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where tactical speed matters more than stamina. Archangel Josepi's consistency in similar conditions gives him the edge in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a messy tactical affair
scenarios.body: The race turns into a lottery where positioning and luck trump class, favoring those held up widest. Denby's Dream or Superstorm could capitalize if they get clear runs.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Quick Quasar or Archangel Josepi race too keenly early and put unexpected pressure on Amber Hamur's lead
Monitor whether South Coast Star gets the strong pace she needs or if the race becomes too tactical for her style
Observe Amber Hamur's early sectionals as she sets the tempo with no obvious pace pressure behind
Check if any of the hold-up horses get shuffled back too far in the small field and struggle for racing room
Watch for Superstorm improving on recent course form if the pace sets up favorably for late closers

races.paceDynamic: With Kindly Queen as the only confirmed front runner alongside prominent racers Rum Diamond, Jambearee and Moon Is Up, the early pace will be moderate rather than searingly fast. This sustainable tempo heavily favors the eight hold-up horses who can track the pace and unleash finishing kicks, particularly dangerous given the 1m4f trip allows plenty of time for positioning.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays moderate with Kindly Queen dictating uncontested
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade gets perfect positioning to unleash coordinated finishing efforts in the straight. Wedonttellthetruth and Blackisthenewblack capitalize on their proven closing ability from the patient tactics.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Kindly Queen goes too slow and the prominent runners fail to apply pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sitting duck scenario where any horse with a turn of foot can win from anywhere. Montu's recent consistent form and hold-up style perfectly suits the tactical finish that develops.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Builds
scenarios.trigger: If Rum Diamond and Moon Is Up push Kindly Queen into faster fractions than ideal
scenarios.body: The pace quickens enough to stretch out the field but the prominent runners pay the price in the final furlong. Late-running Salkadan and Private Project benefit from the stronger gallop to close decisively.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Kindly Queen gets soft fractions and maintains stamina reserves for a fighting finish
scenarios.body: The pace-setter proves hard to peg back when challenged, with any prominent tracker still in contention benefiting from the honest gallop. Kindly Queen holds on with Montu running into second from his tracking position.

watchPoints.text: Rum Diamond, Jambearee and Moon Is Up all show consistent fading patterns that could collapse if they chase early pace
Kindly Queen getting uncontested lead could prove dangerous if fractions become too comfortable for the field
Wedonttellthetruth showing perfect recent form including good going win suggests peak current condition
Eight hold-up horses create traffic concerns in straight if pace stays moderate throughout
Salkadan has minimal recent good going form despite high rating making trip performance uncertain
